verdict.headline: tradfi is NOT 100% canonical. Path structure (S1) and filename/content agreement are close to clean on sampled evidence (>99% in every sample taken). Manifest id-form for captured singles corpus-wide improved dramatically since 07-21 (~99.3% vs 30.8%), consistent with a migration having executed. Two live, currently-unfixed content-correctness defects remain: (1) Yahoo-exclusive venues (ICE/KRX, plus a longstanding FX companion) captured under a databento provenance stamp since ~2026-07-18, contradicting the sourcing SSOT and shipped UAC routing code; (2) tradfi FX SPOT_PAIR manifest instrument_id is 0% well-formed across its entire 2020-2026 history (the real GCS data is fine - only the manifest's copy of the key is wrong). Plus small unchanged legacy findings (BARCHART venue, FUTURES/spot typos, combo writer/reader path disagreement) and a badly stale, rapidly-growing _quarantine/ register entry (146K to >=400K objects in ~3-4 days).
